reviews.text: It's perfect ESPECIALLY with a big dog ! Everything you need right within reach ! Its so much easier than breaking your back bent over a bathtub !

I’m so happy I found this place. I took my puppies to the beach for a fun in the water day 😂 this machines do the job to perfection. Shampoo, conditioner, flea control, dryer, all in one. It was easy to get it done for my 84 and 86 pounds German shepherds. Happy puppies, happy mommy.

It's in front of the building with easy access for able-bodied individuals. Not wheelchair friendly. Each station has a metal gate as an extra barrier between stations. It could be a problem for multiple ppl and dogs, but the solo experience was perfect. No need to set out time for the disinfecting, it adds 20 seconds for free to disinfect.
I love the convenience of the dog wash... if you sanitize the tub when your done it's clean for rhe next person. . I can wash 4 dogs.. if they are dirty then 2 at a time.
Expensive for the used I used another one 29 unlimited time and they give you tools and towels
Its a self dog wash.  $15 for 15 min. Could be a bit longer. We have a lathe dog. Only got 3 min for the blow dry😶

I've never used a DIY self-service dog washing station before, and I didn't quite know what to expect. It's outdoors, on the patio, and it's open 24 hours a day. I was skeptical about that at first, but I can see now that their location makes that very possible. There's a series of gates you go through, and 4 separate wash stations (each with their own gated area). Roxy was hesitant to get in at first, but did great once I got her settled. I was also worried about the amount of time. Roxy is a 60lb long-haired doodle, and I wasn't sure 15 minutes would be enough. It was MORE than enough! I was moving quickly, and I think next time I'll slow down and take my time a bit. We used all the steps: shampoo, rinse, flea treatment, rinse, conditioner, rinse, blow dry. After I got her out of the wash station, I used the free 30 seconds of sanitizer spray for the next person. It's also more than enough time to spray down any dog hair from the walls and floor, while sanitizing the entire area. The blow drier didn't get her ALL the way dry... she's a big girl with lots of hair. But it was really powerful and got her most of the way dry; dry enough for the car ride home. I also love the location. From OB Dog Beach or Fiesta Island, this is right on the way home for anyone in Bay Park or Clairemont. I'm never washing my dog in the driveway again. DoggoWash for life!
No towels.
Nice dog wash stations, warm water, shampoo, conditioner, blower.   Great that avaiable open 24 hours. Need more of these around town.  Dogs love it, we love it not bending over.

Great value at only $16. Everything is provided, including hot water, shampoo, conditioner and disinfectant, plus you can blow dry your dog at the end. Just keep an eye on the time you have For my boxer it was more than enough, but if you have a large long hair dog, you will need to be very focused.Literally no better option for you to use in San Diego aka, supporting a small business!

Great place to wash your dog after Fiesta Island. Super convenient, but 0 frills and no attendant. You literally give the machine your card, then the products (shampoo, flea treatment, and conditioner) come through the hose with the water at the push of a button. No fuss, but you don't get a selection of products. Very acceptable for a quick wash, but not a salon experience one wants to linger over.
What a convenient and cheap way to wash our 3 doggos!
Washing my dog at Doggo is so easy, especially after she plays at Fiesta Island! I I am saving money by washing her myself too.

Love the idea but we took our dogs here after the beach and $16 for 15 min is sooo expensive and barely enough time to wash and dry a husky. Plus the nozzle of the dryer came off and had to have my husband hold it in place. Go to petco, $20 and no time limit.
I love this place, it provides everything you need for their bath and if there's enough time, I can even bathe my two dogs. Highly recommended! 👌🏻
Great self-service dog wash station! $16 for 16 minutes. All the soap/conditioner is included and comes directly out of the water hose. There is a blow dryer as well. 10/10 will use again

Stopped by this self-serve dog wash and had a really good experience. Super convenient location, easy to use setup, and everything was clean and well organized. The staff was friendly and helpful without being overbearing. Made washing the dog quick and hassle-free — definitely a 5-star spot if you’re looking for a simple, no-stress dog wash.

This dog wash is the best! I used to take my pups to their Ocean Beach location a few years ago, so I was really happy to find them again here in Mission Bay. It’s super convenient for dog parents. No more dealing with washing them in a hotel tub.

And for $16, you really can’t beat the price, especially if you can wash both dogs at the same time. Definitely recommend!

This time around I was fortunate enough to meet the staff. She was very helpful and accommodating!

Yesterday was my first time using Doggo wash down by Mission Bay. It was nice to see four separate stalls, along with small enclosed areas for the dogs. The price was a little high for a do it yourself wash, but the machine I used worked fine. Very handy following a visit to fiesta Island.

I took my dog here recently for a regular grooming appointment and overall it was a solid experience. The staff was friendly and didn’t rush through the intake, which I appreciated. My dog can be a little nervous, but they handled him calmly and he seemed comfortable when I picked him up. The haircut was clean and even, and they paid attention to small details like trimming around the paws and ears. It took about the time they quoted, no long waiting around. The place looked organized and smelled pretty clean for a grooming shop. Pricing felt fair for the service. I’d be fine coming back again in the future.
Awesome after your mutts have gotten all sandy at fiesta island. The 15 minute time is enough to wash 3 dogs if you are fast.
Great idea in theory but the credit card machines don’t work. Tried multiple cards, Apple Pay, etc.
Easy access.  Good products.  Very satisfied!

stopped by on our way back from OB. this place is awesome! there’s a parking lot and 4 wash stations. shampoo, flea & tick control, and conditioner provided with the wash. very convenient, easy to use, clean! will definitely be using the other locations as well. ❤️

We checked this place out while we in San Diego. It's clean, the machines are easy to operate and it gets the job done. They even have a towel vending machine if you forget your towel.
What I didn't like-
We purchased a towel even though we brought two because the dryer was pretty much useless (we have a standard poodle with a very short cut on the body). When you finish washing/rinsing, there is no time to towel dry your dog before the dryer time starts. You can pause the machine for one 30 second increment; not enough time to towel dry a dog of that size. So I started to use the dryer to get some of the water off to no avail. Afterwards, I ended up just sitting on the floor and towel drying her with the towels we brought with us and let her sit in the car on the one we purchased from the vending machine. Probably wouldn't use again, but it's a good concept.
Like all bad reviews. Time isn't enough for dry, dirty and cold air and water. They need improve this.
It’s very good idea! But 16,00 for 15min its too short! At least 20 min.we barely have time to dry. Specially big dogs.

We took our dogs to a dog park close by and they got SO DIRTY.  Thankfully we found DoggoWash, and were SUPER IMPRESSED with their system.  I ran a Veterinary Hospital for over 24 years, that included a boarding and grooming facility, so I am VERY familiar with different dog washing systems.  I LOVE that the four tubs are available 24 hours a day, that they were SUPER CLEAN, not expensive, included shampoo if needed, and that the water was the PERFECT temperature right away.  Also, it's worth noting that all of the tubs are enclosed by a gated fence, in case someone tries to run when you're grabbing your phone, keys, etc.  Lisa was cleaning the other tubs, and was EXTREMELY accommodating...we may or may not have a reactive dog.   DoggoWash saved us, since we don't live in the area, and have no way to wash our dogs at our hotel.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Amazing place, super easy, friendly, clean, fast and inexpensive. Highly recommend the north park or morena blvd. Have been to both locations and believe they have more.
DoggoWash is the best! Incredibly convenient, clean, fast in and out. Provides a much needed bath after a morning at OB Dog Beach or Fiesta Island Dog Beach. Open 24/7
Super easy to use and the puppy liked it! It's so much easier to get everything done with this system. It includes all the soap and even has a dryer. 10/10 would recommend
Went after the beach with my 3 dogs , even tho we were outside the temperature for the water and dryer was great
Pretty cool

DoggoWash is a lifesaver! Their self-service stations are always super clean, easy to use, and everything is in perfect working order. It’s clear they stay on top of maintenance, which makes the whole experience stress-free for both me and my dog Orion. Definitely my go-to spot for quick and hassle-free dog baths!

I have now been to doggo wash at least 10 times now. The convenience is great and the water is warm too! I have used two locations and both were nice. The most recent time I started a wash where the hose appeared to be leaking and lacking water pressure. I texted the number on the gate and within 5 minutes I got a response saying they would credit my account back to use another machine which worked perfectly! I sent pictures of the leak and they were sending someone to repair. Overall would recommend and have recommended!

This place is awesome! Too bad it's not open 24hrs since nobody is there running the place. The only thing that kinda bothered me was the dust and animal hair that was about 1½ inches thick on top of the shelves and on top,/behind wash station. Other than that... It was cool.
Easy quick and clean ,
Great place, easy access. Staff is quickly available to answer any questions by text or phone if you come across any issues. Clean!

Most of the dog wash stations where blocked off but I only needed one. It is wonderful to have 24 hour availability. I've never been to a dog washing station before so I'm not sure if $16 for 16 minutes is a reasonable price or not. I would have given a five star if the machine had actually paused the time like it said it would but other then that I am very appreciative of this business.
This place is a hidden gem. Always plenty of parking and centrally located. Just a hop, skip & a jump from fiesta island.
We absolutely love this place! I wash my 2 or some times 3 dogs in 10-12 min!!!!!! perfect after the dog beach!

Dolores, thanks for the 5 stars! 
🙏🏽✨ …

Definitely a nice and quick spot to wash the doge. I could myself at home but for the price and convenience saves me the hassle of all the mess. Has all the amenities built into the machine. The shampoo, conditioner and flea shampoo.
Easy to use
Fantastic service.  I found it on my home from Fiesta Island.  No more cold water yard washoffs for my dogs.  Everything worked perfectly.
10 minutes for $14. App and credit card did not work.

This place is great when things are working and a nightmare when they’re not.  This morning I showed up with both my dogs covered in sand from a romp on fiesta island.    Machines weren’t accepting credit cards or cash and there was no cell service so if you didn’t have their app downloaded to your phone you  basically had no way to pay.  This I discovered after getting my dogs loaded in a tub.  After trying 3 different credit cards and waiting  for 10 minutes for a return text from the “help number,” I finally gave up and loaded my dirty dogs back into my car.  While self-service dog washing is a brilliant idea the equipment still needs monitoring daily to be sure you offer a consistently good product.  As a fellow business owner Ive learned it is the only way to have a happy clientele and a successful business.  I won’t be back here any time soon
Thanks Tony for the great review and for supporting our small business!
This place is awesome 💯 recommend! They are open 24 hours, it's never too crowded but you do need to pay with a credit card. No cash accepted. …
Not really a lot of shampoo or conditioner in the machines.  The last few times we have come here they have been our as well. The water is hot however.
Absolutely wonderful little spot to go and wash your furry friend on the fly.
Always love using this facility after taking our dog to the beach. Always clean, quick and easy to use.
Thanks for the review and for supporting our small business!
I love this place!!!!Makes washing both of my Huskies a piece of cake. Thank you Doggo wash💞 …
Finally a place I can wash 2 dogs at once 24hrs a day! So easy, so fast! Love it
Fantastic place, I have two Great Danes and they can comfortably fit into the tubs while I wash them. Reasonable price. Low and high speed blow dryer. Wash-Condition-Flea treatment-Dryer
